title: SimPlantContract
description: The messages of the simulator socket, as one type for the schema.

state.description: The simulator's reply to each step.

SimHello.description: The simulator's first line: who it is, and where the arm starts.

joint_names.description:
The URDF joint names the simulator serves: the arm's, then the gripper's
when it has one. They must equal the controller's driven joints.

SimState.description:
What the simulator measures after a step. Efforts are in the profile's effort
unit (percent of rated for the SO-101 profiles).

gripper_angle.description: The jaw's angle in the URDF's gripper joint; present when the arm has one.

positions.description: The arm's joints, in the order of the hello's `joint_names`.

SimStep.description: What the controller sends each cycle.

gripper_angle.description: The jaw's target angle, when the arm has a gripper.

positions.description: Position targets for the arm's joints.

powered.description:
Whether the arm's actuators have torque. When unpowered, the arm moves
under gravity, passive forces and contacts without actuator torque.

seconds.description: How much simulated time this step lasts.
